body: Pretty nice stuff on your blog @vsavkin thanks!

For anyone needing to import ValidatorFn while using rc1 the import statement is:

`import {ValidatorFn} from '@angular/common/src/forms/directives/validators';`

I tend to need this quite a bit in my components so it would be very welcome if added to the '@angular/common' barrel of fun.

With RC2 and the new forms module, the import has changed to

`import {ValidatorFn} from "@angular/forms/esm/src/directives/validators";`
@achimha that's an invalid import. You should not import from `@angular/somemodule/src/...` because the `src/` directory is considered private implementation.
Then that's a reason to make `ValidatorFn` available in the RC2 forms barrel. cc @jeffbcross @vsavkin

issue.title: feat(forms): expose ValidatorFn and AsyncValidatorFn
issue.body:
This PR exposes the `ValidatorFn` and `AsyncValidatorFn` interfaces.

See https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/8834.
